Your VaultInk reader, from the phone

VaultInk is the software on your e-reader that reads your Obsidian Vaults from its SD card. This app is its companion: it talks to the reader over Wi-Fi, so you can send it notes, manage its card and change its settings from the phone.
On the reader, open File Transfer and pick Join a Network (the same Wi-Fi as the phone) or Create Hotspot (then join the reader\'s Wi-Fi on the phone). Keep that screen open while you use the app.

Note: write a quick note or share text and pictures from other apps. It\'s saved on the reader\'s card right away; with LiveSync set up, the reader also sends it to your other devices on its next sync.
Files: the whole SD card. Upload, download, rename, move and delete.
Settings: the reader\'s settings, by category. Changes apply right away.
Device: the reader\'s address and firmware version, and app updates.
On the reader, File Transfer must be open, and the phone on the same Wi-Fi or on the reader\'s hotspot.
1. On the reader, open File Transfer and leave it open.
2. Put the phone on the same Wi-Fi, or join the reader\'s hotspot.
Still nothing? Type the address the reader shows at the top of its File Transfer screen.
Saved on the reader\'s card right away. With LiveSync set up, the reader sends it on its next sync.
